_comment: The controlled four-arm V pilot (docs/FEATURE_FAMILIES.md). Every arm: the same frozen-carrier rows (designated seat of bots/p_only/profiles/collect_v_data.json), targets (final pairwise utility under that carrier and the reference roster), map-grouped splits, evaluation (training.evaluate_value) and training procedure; arms differ only in feature family and hidden widths. One training seed per arm for the pilot; three independent seeds for finalists. One shared model conditioned on the team count (`general`), not one per count. The committed M value (inference/models_m, v2, mixed-roster data) is an extra reference. Commands: the GPU task's Goal.

frozen.policy: inference/models_xxl (family p2, committed XXL, every team-count model)
frozen.search: v12 rollout_volley as in bots/p_only/bots/v12_ponly.hpp, fixed time, V off
frozen.opponents: roster.strength reference roster frozen in the collection schedule
frozen.refresh: after a V changes the carrier's play substantially, version that carrier and collect again

training.batch: from the sweep: the largest of 2048, 4096, 8192 that fits with margin; the same for every arm

rank.note: first pilot without ranking (0.0); a ranking arm repeats the best shape with 0.5
